as_told.title: Eric Davis tells Congress the NHI are controlling disclosure

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that at a closed hearing in the US Congress in 2025, with Lou Elizondo, the researcher Avi Loeb and a man named Eric Davis present, Davis said that NHI, short for non-human intelligence, are themselves controlling disclosure. Disclosure here means the public release of what governments know about them. If true, it would mean the beings, not officials, decide what we learn and when.
